how_to_apply: TNPSC CTSE Interview Posts Apply Online can be completed by following the steps below.
Visit the official TNPSC application website, www.tnpscexams.in.
If not already registered, complete the One Time Registration (OTR) by paying the Rs. 150 registration fee. Keep a scanned photograph (20–50 KB) and signature (10–20 KB) ready before starting OTR.
If already registered, log in to the OTR dashboard directly.
Proceed to fill up the online application for the Combined Technical Services Examination (Interview Posts).
Select the subject paper(s) that match the educational/technical qualification you hold for the post(s) you wish to apply for.

Upload the required documents and pay the examination fee of Rs. 200 per subject paper (plus Rs. 200 for each additional subject paper) through Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card, or UPI, unless fee exemption is claimed.
Review all entries carefully and click the "Submit" button. An application is considered complete only after final submission - merely previewing it is not sufficient.
Note the Application Number / Applicant ID generated after successful payment for future reference.
Use the Application Correction Window (10.10.2026 to 12.10.2026) if any correction is needed; no changes are allowed after this window closes.
important_instructions: Admission to the written examination, certificate verification, interview, or counselling is purely provisional and does not confer any right to appointment. Candidates should choose subject paper(s) only in the field(s) where they hold the required educational or equivalent qualification. Banned items such as mobile phones, smart watches, Bluetooth devices, calculators, and any other communication or storage devices are not allowed inside the examination hall. The Commission reserves the right to include additional posts with similar eligibility conditions under this notification. The rule of reservation of appointments applies to this recruitment, except that reservation for Destitute Widow and Ex-Servicemen does not apply overall (though certain individual posts do carry these concessions, as noted in the age limit section). The notification is published in both English and Tamil; in case of any discrepancy, the English version is treated as final. Requests for exemption from age limit, qualification, or other eligibility conditions will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: TNPSC CTSE Interview Posts Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for TNPSC CTSE Interview Posts Recruitment 2026 is made through a Written Examination followed by an Interview. Written Examination: Conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) with Paper I (Part A – Tamil Eligibility Test, Part B – General Studies, Part C – Aptitude and Mental Ability) and Paper II (Subject Paper related to the chosen post). For Tamil Reporter and English Reporter posts, Paper II is a Stenography subject paper of Diploma standard. Minimum Qualifying Marks: Part B and Part C of Paper I and Paper II are evaluated only if a candidate scores at least 40% (60 marks) in Part A of Paper I. Onscreen Certificate Verification: Conducted before physical certificate verification and interview; candidates are admitted in the ratio of 1:3/1:4 (posts without experience requirement) or 1:10 (posts requiring experience), based on minimum qualifying marks and reservation rules. Physical Certificate Verification and Interview: Candidates are shortlisted based on marks obtained, subject to the number of vacancies in each reservation category (two or three times the vacancies, depending on the category size). Interview: Assesses the candidate's personality, bearing, aptitude, general knowledge, and technical knowledge relevant to the post. Final Merit List: Based on the total of marks from Part B and Part C of Paper I, Paper II, and the Interview (maximum 510 marks in total), subject to the rule of reservation of appointments. Appearance in Paper I, Paper II, and the Interview is compulsory; candidates who miss any of these will not be considered for selection even if they meet the minimum qualifying marks elsewhere.

faq.question: What is the application fee for TNPSC CTSE Interview Posts?
faq.answer: Rs. 150/- for One Time Registration and Rs. 200/- per subject paper as examination fee, with full or partial fee exemptions for SC, SC(A), ST, BC, PWD, Destitute Widow, and Ex-Servicemen candidates.

faq.question: How can I apply online for TNPSC CTSE Interview Posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must complete One Time Registration and then apply online through www.tnpscexams.in before the last date, as detailed in the How to Apply section above.

faq.question: What is the selection process for TNPSC CTSE Interview Posts?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a Written Examination (Paper I and Paper II) followed by an Interview, with final ranking based on the combined marks out of a Grand Total of 510.
